metadata.title: This AI Stock Is Surging, But Can It Shake the ‘Meme Stock’ Label?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
This AI Stock Is Surging. Can It Shake the ‘Meme Stock’ Label?
Shares of Applied Optoelectronics jumped Friday after the networking supplier reported earnings, giving a boost to investors who hope it can be more than a meme stock.
